heroHeadline: Day 826: 14 Killed in Culiacán and Mazatlán, Six Young People Abducted in One Day
heroSubtitle: Reports of Oct 27 cite 12–14 homicides across Culiacán and Mazatlán and six abductions in eastern Culiacán; Security Secretary García Harfuch visited Sinaloa on Oct 28.
